headline: Festive season bookings, gift ideas and the 947 Ride weekend.
notes: First set, written in the setup chat from the 16 Nov trends and the package prices on the website. No campaigns set yet.

messages.title: Festive season bookings
messages.text:
*Festive season is nearly here* 🎄

Year-end functions, family photos, matric farewells and Christmas lunches are all coming up fast, and the good dates go first.

If you want photos or a reel of yours, now's the time to grab a date. Our Mini Shoot starts at R500 (30 minutes, 20 photos or a reel), and full photo and video packages are on the site.

Book here 👉 https://www.fomstudios.co.za/?src=wach

FOM Studios 📸
messages.photo: A warm, festive shot from a past event or family shoot (lights, smiles, a table set for a party).
messages.why: Late November to mid December is peak function season in South Africa, and people book early for festive photos.

messages.title: Gift idea
messages.text:
*Stuck on a gift idea?* 🎁

A photo session is a present people actually keep. Think a couple shoot for your partner, a family session for your parents, or a fun Mini Shoot with your friends.

Mini Shoots start at R500 and you choose the date that suits you.

Have a look 👉 https://www.fomstudios.co.za/?src=wach

FOM Studios 📸
messages.photo: A couple or family photo with a natural, happy moment.
messages.why: With Black Friday on 27 Nov, people are planning gifts now and save ideas to send to their partners.

messages.title: 947 Ride weekend
messages.text:
*Riding the 947 this Sunday?* 🚴

Good luck to everyone taking on the 947 Ride Joburg! If your club or team wants proper photos or a reel of your ride this season, from training rides to race day, we'd love to shoot it.

Sports and event packages 👉 https://www.fomstudios.co.za/?src=wach
